$BTC In 2022, the market bottomed on the 21st of November so this is exactly 4 years ago now.

News lows made, putting the total bear market duration at 400+ days now.

4 Cycle theory has always been a strong guideline for this market and it has proven itself pretty accurate yet again.

But while the dates line up pretty well, the percentages and moves have not. 2025 closed red and this year likely will too. Never before has Bitcoin closed 2 consecutive years in the red. 

This would also be the smallest bear market drawdown by far if it were to bottom in the $50K region. But that is a trend we've already been seeing a long time. Both the ups and the downs are getting smaller with every cycle.

News lows made, putting the total bear market duration at 400+ days now.

4 Cycle theory has always been a strong guideline for this market and it has proven itself pretty accurate yet again.

But while the dates line up pretty well, the percentages and moves have not. 2025 closed red and this year likely will too. Never before has Bitcoin closed 2 consecutive years in the red. 

This would also be the smallest bear market drawdown by far if it were to bottom in the $50K region. But that is a trend we've already been seeing a long time. Both the ups and the downs are getting smaller with every cycle.
